title: RecordExpiration

Expiration.description: Specifies whether journal table record expiration is enabled or disabled.

Days.description: If you enable journal table record expiration, you can set the number of days to retain your journal table records. Journal table records must be retained for a minimum of 7 days. To set this value, specify any whole number from 7 to 2147483647. For example, to retain your journal table records for one year, set this value to 365.

description: The journal table record expiration settings for a journal table in an S3 Metadata configuration.
